# DMTREE

Another name for TREE.

## Syntax

```text
DMTREE dependent BY predictors [/subcommands of TREE].
```

The same command as TREE, with the same subcommands and defaults.

## Example

```text
DMTREE bought [n] BY region [n] age_group [o] /GROWTHLIMIT MAXDEPTH=2.
```

`statscraft help DMTREE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
